apparent_contradiction: Directness helps men vs indirect emotional entry helps men
evidence_on_each_side: Sharp et al. (2024/25): men prefer coded, colloquial mental-health language. Same study: men prefer dynamic, action, growth language. Male-facing brands and programmes use blunt imperatives.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: The same 64 men wanted BOTH. Reviews find no universal advantage for blunt problem-focused wording.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Not a contradiction: 'directness' was never one variable.
boundary_condition: Decompose into diagnostic, emotional, informational, behavioural, interpersonal, moral directness and CTA pressure. These move independently.
design_implication: A message can be emotionally indirect AND behaviourally explicit. That combination is the modal recommendation in male-facing health practice.

apparent_contradiction: Masculinity framing increases relevance vs masculinity framing produces reactance
evidence_on_each_side: Brough et al. (2016): masculine cues increase men's uptake of feminine-coded green products. White & Dahl: public feminine labels are avoided. VS Real Men Real Depression: masculinity label added nothing over neutral; Scholz et al.: masculine framing did not move traditional men; masculine job-ad wording narrows the pool.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: Both bodies of evidence are experimental and neither is weak.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Boundary condition is the PRIOR GENDER-CODING of the behaviour and the PUBLIC VISIBILITY of the response.
boundary_condition: Masculine cues resolve an identity problem that already exists. Where no gender problem exists, adding gender creates an identity negotiation instead of removing one.
design_implication: For a men's mental-health organisation the relevant question is empirical, not stylistic: is help-seeking currently feminine-coded for THIS audience, in PUBLIC or in PRIVATE? Untested in Indonesia.

apparent_contradiction: Status motivates vs status pressure produces shame
evidence_on_each_side: Manosphere literature: status legibility and aspiration are strong retention mechanisms. Indonesian evidence: kemapanan and provider identity organise male self-worth. VS Man Box data: inability to fulfil the provider role is associated with by far the largest suicidal-ideation multiplier reported in that literature.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: Both are about the same construct.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Depends on whether the recipient's status is currently ATTAINABLE or currently FAILING.
boundary_condition: Status framing is aspirational for a man who can still climb and annihilating for a man who has already fallen short. The same sentence changes valence with the audience's position.
design_implication: Never use provider/achievement framing as the default entry frame in a mental-health context, because the men most at risk are disproportionately those for whom that frame is currently failing.

apparent_contradiction: Humour lowers social distance vs humour trivialises distress
evidence_on_each_side: Ofcom: humour is the single most common reported attraction. Man Therapy is built on parody. VS Man Therapy RCT was null on clinical outcomes; banter can normalise exclusion and make topics undiscussable.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: The strongest humour evidence is about ENTRY, the strongest counter-evidence is about OUTCOMES.
boundary_condition: Humour has good evidence as an attention/entry device and no isolated evidence as a persuasion or clinical mechanism. Its risk rises monotonically with severity.
design_implication: Permissible in low-risk entry content; not in acute-risk content. This is a stage rule, not a taste rule.

apparent_contradiction: Moral emotion increases diffusion vs moral saturation decreases engagement
evidence_on_each_side: Brady et al.: each moral-emotional word ~+13% sharing. VS Candia et al.: conditional on moral loading, higher moral density predicts LOWER engagement.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Absolute moral LOADING vs moral DENSITY (proportion).
boundary_condition: Two posts can carry the same amount of moral content but very different concentrations. Loading raises diffusion; concentration eventually suppresses it.
design_implication: Design implication: keep moral meaning present but surrounded by non-moral substance (facts, story, practical content). Do NOT chase a numeric ratio.

apparent_contradiction: Male identity creates belonging vs identity policing creates rejection
evidence_on_each_side: Men's Sheds, FFIT, MATES: male-specific settings facilitate engagement. VS 'Real men' constructions make group membership conditional; Man Up campaign critique; ~20% adolescent resistance to collective-indictment framing.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Whether the framing ADDRESSES the group or REGULATES it.
boundary_condition: Male-specific INFRASTRUCTURE (a space where men happen to feel comfortable) is a different intervention from masculinity-explicit PERSUASION (telling men what masculinity should mean). These are routinely conflated as 'male-friendly'.
design_implication: An organisation can be unambiguously for men without making any claim about what a man is.

apparent_contradiction: Masculinity inhibits Indonesian help-seeking vs masculinity shows no effect in Indonesia
evidence_on_each_side: Chandra & Himawan: masculinity ideology explains 11.4% of variance in help-seeking ATTITUDES among young Chinese-Indonesian men. VS Hadisuyatmana et al.: masculinity ideology, norms and GRC show NO significant correlation with primary-care USE among Surabaya men aged 20-40.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: Both are Indonesian, both are cross-sectional.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Different outcomes (attitudes vs utilisation), different domains (mental vs physical), different populations (young ethnic-minority urban vs general urban).
boundary_condition: Not a genuine contradiction. It demonstrates that domain, outcome, ethnicity and age all matter, and that no general 'Indonesian masculinity blocks care' claim is supported.
design_implication: Do not build strategy on the assumption that masculinity is the primary Indonesian barrier. The dissertation's finding that Community and SES dominate is better supported.

apparent_contradiction: Manosphere audiences are lonely, failing men vs manosphere audiences are advantaged and optimistic
evidence_on_each_side: Incel literature: very high depression, isolation, suicidality. VS Movember and Equimundo: influencer followers more employed, educated, higher-income, partnered; equally lonely to peers; more optimistic.
actual_distinguishing_variable: The unit of analysis. Incels are a small, bounded, heavily studied subpopulation; masculinity-influencer audiences are a mass population.
boundary_condition: Incels are over-represented in scholarship relative to their share of the ecosystem. Findings about severe isolation cannot be transferred to a teenager watching gym content.
design_implication: Do not design communication for Indonesian men aged 18-35 on the assumption that the manosphere-adjacent audience is a distressed minority. It is closer to the mainstream.

apparent_contradiction: Engagement indicates success vs engagement indicates hostility
evidence_on_each_side: Moral-contagion literature: moral-emotional content spreads. VS Corporate-activism meta-analysis found NO reliable pooled association with social-media engagement; Gillette's dislikes exceeded likes; virality itself increases outrage.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: Not a contradiction about wording; a contradiction about what engagement measures.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Valence and endogeneity of the metric.
boundary_condition: Engagement conflates approval, hostility, algorithmic selection and audience-composition shift.
design_implication: Never treat likes, shares or comment volume as evidence of trust or persuasion. Measure them separately and code comment valence.
status: RESOLVED - ENGAGEMENT IS NOT AN OUTCOME

apparent_contradiction: Reframing help-seeking as strength reduces stigma vs it preserves the norm that causes stigma
evidence_on_each_side: Practice and BCT reviews: strengths-based framing is among the promising components. VS Rigid masculinity is itself associated with self-stigma; 'a strong man asks for help' preserves the premise that a man must prove strength.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: Short-term engagement and long-term norm change are different outcomes and are rarely measured together.
boundary_condition: This is a real, unresolved empirical and ethical tension - masculinity ACCOMMODATION vs masculinity EXPANSION. Current evidence does not establish either as superior.
design_implication: State the tension explicitly rather than resolving it rhetorically. Prefer framings that do not make worth conditional on any trait at all.

apparent_contradiction: Shame and confrontation motivate change vs shame backfires
evidence_on_each_side: Public-health tradition of confrontational campaigning (CALM's 'smash the silence'). VS Anti-incel messaging trial where ridicule had no positive effect and one shaming condition INCREASED violent fantasies; reactance meta-analysis.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: The direct wording test points one way.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Whether the audience is positioned as the culprit.
boundary_condition: Confrontation directed at a SILENCE or a SYSTEM behaves differently from confrontation directed at the RECIPIENT.
design_implication: Confrontational energy is available; collective indictment of the audience is not.
status: RESOLVED BY TARGET OF THE CONFRONTATION

apparent_contradiction: Peer/informal voice builds trust vs formality provides useful authority
evidence_on_each_side: Peer programmes (MATES) and colloquial brand copy. VS NIVEA credibly uses pria/Anda/kamu in an expert register; clinical precision is required for risk content; Indonesian respondents valued health professionals' communication quality.
why_it_looks_like_a_contradiction: Both are true of different jobs.
actual_distinguishing_variable: Which relationship the content needs to construct, and whether the speaker is licensed for it.
boundary_condition: Register is not ranked; it is assigned. Peer voice buys closeness and costs authority; formal voice buys authority and costs closeness.
design_implication: One organisation needs both, allocated by content type - not a single house register.
